    • promoteArithmetic

      public static Class<?> promoteArithmetic(Class<?> c1, Class<?> c2)
      Given the types of the two operands of an arithmetic operation, return the type of its result, which both operands are converted to before the operation. This is promote(Class, Class), except that, as the numeric promotion rules of the specification require, an operation on a BigDecimal or BigInteger and a Double or Float has the floating point type: Double if an operand is Double, else Float, BigDecimal, BigInteger, Long and Integer, in that order.

    • promoteForComparison

      public static Class<?> promoteForComparison(Class<?> c1, Class<?> c2)
      Given the types of two values that are compared, return the type they should both be converted to before the comparison. This is promote(Class, Class), except that a java.time value compared to a java.util.Date is compared as the java.time type, and two different java.util.Date types are compared as timestamps if one of them is a timestamp and as plain dates otherwise.

    • toSqlDate

      public static Date toSqlDate(Date date)
      The Date of the day of the given date in the default time zone, normalized to the start of that day as JDBC requires. new java.sql.Date(millis) keeps the time of day, which drivers such as Oracle's bind as part of a DATE value.

      public static List<String> parseDeclaration(String dec, char split, String decType)

    • parseJDBCTemporalSyntax

      public static Object parseJDBCTemporalSyntax(String s)
      Parses the given string assuming it is a JDBC key expression. Extracts the data portion and based on the key, calls static java.sql.Date/Time/Timestamp.valueOf(String) method to convert to a java.sql.Date/Time/Timestamp instance.
